{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -l

#FLUX --job-name=jobname
#FLUX --nodes=1
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1
#FLUX --time=00:05:00
#FLUX --mem=20G

# NOTE: The --mail-user (-M) and mail-type (-m) directives have been omitted as
# Flux does not have a direct equivalent for job status email notifications.
#

# The Flux equivalent of PBS_O_WORKDIR is FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR
cd $FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR

set -u # fail when using an undefined variable
set -x # echo script lines as they are executed
set -e # abort at first error

module load Python/3.7.4-GCCcore-8.3.0
module load h5py/2.10.0-intel-2019b-Python-3.7.4
module load netcdf4-python/1.5.3-intel-2019b-Python-3.7.4

./myprogram.sh

exit
"
}
